rows.grounds: compound with internal sandhi joining attainment of powers and the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula attainment alongside the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are enumerated as attained.
Attainment of powers is joined with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The root Kaula encompasses both the eight powers and their attainment as a unified realization.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O fair-faced one, there are the eight powers and the attainment of powers, which together constitute the root Kaula.
